summary: Backend-only testing of new reseller API manual renew endpoints (hosting/vps/rdp) at http://127.0.0.1:5000/reseller/v1. Seeded test data (apifix01/apifix02 cpanel, vps-test-1, rdp-test-1) and ran 21 pytest cases covering happy paths, period/month clamping, unknown-id 404s, auth 401s, apidoc rendering, and renewals listing regression. All 21 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Shared vpsRenewHandler cleanly handles both VPS (PAYG wallet+expiry) and RDP (provider-term pricing) branches via isRDP flag — good DRY.
All renew endpoints correctly route through billedProvision (dry_run on sandbox, charge+provision on live), so wallet semantics stay consistent with other provisioning calls.
Hosting renew clamps periods 1..12, VPS clamps months 1..12, RDP clamps months 1..3 (matches provider bundle availability). Verified via tests.
apidoc page renders without 'render error' and documents all three new POST /{product}/.../renew routes.
seed_data_creation: Ran scripts/seed_reseller_test_hosting.js (apifix01 Golden, apifix02 Premium) and scripts/seed_reseller_test_vps_rdp.js (vps-test-1 $18, rdp-test-1 standard-1m $56).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All renews return dry_run envelope on this sandbox. Expected prices: hosting Golden 100/period, VPS 18/month, RDP 56 (1m) / ~100.8 (2m) / ~142.8 (3m). RDP clamps at 3 months; hosting/VPS at 12. Reseller API runs on Node bot port 5000 under /reseller/v1 (NOT the FastAPI /api prefix).
